repeat_decisions.rationale: 2016 asks recursive status of three languages: at least 2016 steps on some input, on all inputs, and acceptance of epsilon. 2021 asks decidability of only two languages, more than 2021 steps on all/some inputs. Removing the epsilon-acceptance language changes the requested proposition set beyond a numerical bound substitution.
Both ask the symbolic CNF derivation-step count for a word of length n: n terminal plus n−1 binary productions.
Both test whether regularity of one operand and its union forces the other operand regular; it does not.
